# Asanka's Personal Blog
# https://asanka.blog
# Author: Asanka Tharindu (Sri Lankan international student, Melbourne, Australia)
# Topics: mental health, international student life in Australia, lived experience
# Last updated: 2026-06-22

> A first-person blog about mental health and international student life in Australia,
> written by Asanka Tharindu, a Sri Lankan who moved to Melbourne in 2018.
> Content is based on lived experience, not clinical advice.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://asanka.blog/): Overview of the blog — mental health, migration, and community.
- [My Story](https://asanka.blog/story.html): Asanka's personal story — the 2004 tsunami, the Sri Lankan civil war, moving to Melbourne alone in 2018, and the cost of studying abroad nobody talks about.
- [Blog](https://asanka.blog/blog.html): All posts, organised by mental health, international student life, and resources.

## Most important content

- [The Phone Call That Saved My Life](https://asanka.blog/the-phone-call-that-saved-my-life.html):
  A first-person account of a mental health crisis experienced by a Sri Lankan international
  student in Melbourne in 2020. Covers family pressure, suicidal ideation, and the moment a
  friend's phone call averted a tragedy. Includes a full list of free, 24/7 Australian mental
  health crisis lines available to international students (no Medicare required):
  Lifeline 13 11 14, Beyond Blue 1300 22 4636, Suicide Call Back Service 1300 659 467,
  MensLine 1300 78 99 78, TIS National interpreter service 131 450.
